name: @w6w-apps/ollama-cloud
description: Run prompts, chats and embeddings against Ollama's hosted cloud API with an API key.

w6w.longDescription:
Ollama Cloud serves the same models as a local Ollama install, hosted by the vendor, and this app calls it directly: you paste an API key from ollama.com and the app talks to https://ollama.com with it. A workflow can generate text from a prompt, continue a chat conversation, produce embeddings, and ask for structured JSON that matches a schema, with images for vision models and sampling options such as temperature, seed and context size. The models the account can call can be listed, and the service version read, so a workflow's model choice stays explicit rather than hardcoded.

The difference from the `Ollama` app is where the model runs. There is no server to host, no LAN address to reach and no hardware to size: the trade is an API key, a usage limit and the vendor's model list instead of your own. Every call is non-streaming. Model management stays with the vendor — the cloud API exposes no pull, copy, delete or unload — so a model the account does not have access to answers 404, and `List models` shows what it does.
